scope: Local House calls operator and Senate probe classification, session 45-1.

archive.verification: Each decompressed original matched its advertised SHA-256 and byte count. Both source databases were opened with mode=ro and immutable=1 against the retained checkpointed files. The operator wrote exclusively to a small disposable replica.

outcome.comparison: Two operator replays matched every November 25 receipt field except the generation timestamp. Records, links, revisions and change events stayed identical between replays.

regression.before: A replay after the November 25 publication counted the same saved instructions twice, advancing revision 6 to 7.
regression.after: A repeat of that capture preserves revision 6 and the pending change. A complete later publisher observation can confirm a pending change even when its bytes match.

reproduction.fixture: The exact replay uses the retained November 25 receipt, its downloads.sqlite source descriptors, committee.sqlite post-publication call and study rows, and gzip originals at objects/<first two digest characters>/<digest>.gz. Run at the repository root using the matching checkpointed files with no outstanding SQLite WAL. The checked-in CachedOperatorTest exercises the same hold, confirmation, drop and relisting cases with a self-contained fixture.
commands: for file in "$replica/first.json" "$replica/second.json"; do diff <(jq -S 'del(.generatedAt)' dist/refresh/receipts/committee-calls.json) <(jq -S 'del(.generatedAt)' "$file") || exit 1; done
